name: Industrial Age
tagline: Steam, soot, and spokes. Mind the boiler.
intro: Smoke on the horizon. Someone has built a factory whose only purpose is to reinvent the wheel. It is you. You built it.

explosions: KABOOM. The boiler has left the building. So has part of the building.
The boiler exploded. Health and Safety will be invented in roughly 100 years.
Boiler explosion! A worker's hat lands three towns over. It is round. Close enough?
The boiler made a noise like a kettle the size of a cathedral, and then it made a much louder one.
shovelQuips: Your arms are getting enormous. Industrial-strength biceps.
Somewhere, a coal miner sighs with pride.
You've shoveled so much coal you are now 40% soot.
A child asks why you don't just buy a Coal Stoker. You pretend not to hear.
